messages:
Inez: hello everyone! Inez here, joining Eng Infra today. excited to meet folks and learn the runtime. :tada:
Inez: tiny intro: former barista, amateur pianist, and i will defend oat milk to the end.
Lola: welcome Inez!! :wave: oat milk alliance noted. hope you bring keyboard skills to the weekly lunch jam.
Ben: hi Inez — if you ever need a coffee break buddy i'm around. ps our espresso machine has a labeled cheat-sheet on the fridge.
HR-bot: Hi Inez :wave: Your badge is at reception. First-week onboarding lunch is Thursday at 12:30. Please complete the safety waiver.
Inez: thanks! where's the best spot to plug in for a long coding session? need lots of outlets.
Lola: 3B has power strips and a window view. also 1A has comfy chairs if you want to practice piano during breaks.
Ben: also FYI there's an informal mug registry in the kitchen drawer (yes, people put names). bring your fox mug!
DevEx-bot: @Inez — IT ticket created. Run `bootstrap.sh` after laptop arrival to get VPN + slack groups.
Inez: will do. also curious if anyone participates in the rooftop picnic tradition on Fridays?
Lola: we do when weather behaves. snacks are potluck-style.
Ben: count me in this Friday. I bring cookies.
Inez: cookies and piano? sounds perfect. thanks for the warm welcome all :heart: 
HR-bot: New hire checklist: badge collected ✔, onboarding tasks pending. Welcome aboard!
